text: ἡ Γλαὺξ φοβεῖται, ἀλλὰ ὁ ὑπερβρέφος οὐ φοβεῖται.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a small gray stone that fits in one hand
a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
positioning: Hyperbrephos stands confidently with a determined expression, showing no fear
Glaux cowers behind Hyperbrephos, trembling with the red ball still in her wings
Lukos continues approaching with threatening intent
The bright red leather ball is clutched by the frightened Glaux
The white leather ball remains on the ground
The small gray stone is near Hyperbrephos's feet
The large gray boulder sits ominously nearby
